About the author

Matthew Thomas is a native of Arizona, growing up in Phoenix. He is married to his wife of 33 years and has three children. Matt was employed with the Pinal County Sheriff ’s Office for over 32 years, starting his career as a Detention Officer in 1993 and promoted through the ranks to his last position held of Chief Deputy. Having served in several specialty units—Detention, Patrol, Traffic, Training, the Police Academy, Motors, Narcotics, and Investigations. Having served 18 years on the Pinal Regional SWAT team as a member, team leader, and finishing as the team commander, he was involved in and/or led over 700 missions during his tenure on SWAT.
